name: hanzo-docs
description: Hanzo Docs — the documentation framework and hub for the Hanzo ecosystem (docs.hanzo.ai).

scripts.release: turbo run build --filter=./packages/* && pnpm -r publish --access public --no-git-checks && changeset tag
scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/update-stackblitz-versions.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
